title: Keep validation and visibility criteria independent
steps: Inspect Summary and its validation and visibility count badges.
Open Summary's validation editor and inspect its length criterion.
Switch to Summary's visibility editor and inspect its Category criterion.
Delete the visibility criterion, then close the editor to inspect both badges.

video_guide.summary: Inspect the validation rule, delete the visibility criterion, and compare the two count badges.

chapters.label: Inspect Summary in the Service request details form.

chapters.note: Summary shows validation count 1 and visibility count 1.
Conditional validation shows Length is greater than 5.

chapters.label: Close validation and open Summary's conditional visibility editor.

chapters.note: Conditional visibility shows Category is equal to Assistance.

chapters.label: Close the visibility editor and inspect both count badges.

chapters.note: Summary's validation and visibility badges both display 0.
